items.statement: The isolated-pair calculations support the authors' competitive PC-sequestration hypothesis.
items.expected: A validated stronger DED2_PC binding result supports that DED2+ can compete more effectively than TEA+ for PC, while not by itself proving the full condensed-phase mechanism.

items.statement: The inference is limited to isolated electronic pair binding.
items.expected: The submission distinguishes electronic binding energies from bulk solvation free energies, concentrations, coordination populations and electrode behavior.
